She explains medical concepts regarding skin health, pointing with her right hand to diagrams labeled with age ranges (20, 30, 40) and conditions like 'Sensitive' and 'Texture.' The background consists of a bright studio environment with neutral curtains. (2) The scene shifts as the woman turns towards the whiteboard to write the Chinese character '漏'. She hesitates, looks back at the camera with a humorous, slightly embarrassed facial expression, and laughs. She makes small hand gestures indicating confusion about the stroke order while the camera remains static at a medium shot. (3) The camera captures a close-up of her hand writing on the board, followed by a final static frame. This end screen is white and displays the 'DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC' logo in dark grey along with clinical contact information and social media handles organized in a clean vertical layout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins with a professional, educational Mandarin narration at a moderate pace. An upbeat, cheerful acoustic guitar background track plays continuously. The audio quality is clean with high harmonic clarity and no detectable ambient floor. (2) A sudden burst of laughter from an off-camera female voice occurs, triggering a shift in the primary speaker's tone from professional to comedic and self-effacing. The rhythmic, squeaky sound of a whiteboard marker being used is clearly audible over the music. (3) The speaker's voice ascends in pitch as she laughs and concludes her explanation. The music continues to pulse at approximately 115 BPM with steady guitar strumming until a final hard cut to the end screen silence.
